rationale: The ES 8.8 aggregate workflow row gives Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+ while the current task gives 10.2+/ES 8.7+ and distinguishes CMP Cloud Connected Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0 with paired SOAR. The current task carries finding limits, frontier model requirements and inherited connector and asset-action permissions. The 8.7 Cloud-only SOC Analyst guide is historical. Current editions material still groups Triage separately from the aggregate workflow, and the older Triage wording correction is not universal component entitlement. The 8.8 release page now explicitly describes November 4 GA after CA. The ES regional tables and SAIA install page retain their own component and deployment scopes.
